name: Constrained CPU emulation
description: Same code/image as Platform A, constrained by OS/container scheduling and memory limits. This is not a real embedded device.
docker_run_example: docker run --rm --cpus=1 --memory=512m -v "$PWD:/app" -w /app ps-p1 python -m src.benchmark --platform B --iterations 1000 --warmup 100 --batches 5
verification: cgroup CPU quota must be detectable and <= required_cpu_quota_cores
cgroup memory limit must be detectable and <= required_memory_mib
notes: Change limits only if documented before benchmarking; retain the same limit for all suites and record the exact observed values.
